propositions: The complexity-baseline.json file lacks a CI lock mechanism to prevent unauthorized changes, unlike module-size-limit.txt which is locked against main in _build-and-test.yml

New complexity-baseline entries can be added in a single change without triggering CI failure because the current test only validates schema and count consistency, not whether entries are monotonically non-increasing
The CI lock must perform semantic comparison of the ceilings mapping to detect raised ceilings or added entries as violations while permitting removed entries and lowered ceilings
The module-size-limit lock currently fails open with a warning when git fetch of main fails, allowing unverified changes to pass; both locks must fail closed instead
A function exceeding the C901 complexity threshold must fail CI build even when a matching baseline entry is added in the same change
